title.label: Such a frustrating app to use

content.label:
Do the automatic downloads work…? Who knows, sometimes they do, sometimes they don’t🤷🏻‍♂️ When you inevitably run into one of the episodes that this app decided not to download, doesn’t seem to matter how strong the wifi/cellular is… it’ll take a solid minute or two to start playing (if it ever does, it sometimes just gets stuck trying) because somehow this app hasn’t figured out how to stream stuff properly… I guess. Try and curate what order you want to listen to your podcasts and… sometimes it works, sometimes it doesn’t (a bit of a theme, I know)
It used to be a good app, and I really don’t want to hunt down all the shows I’m subscribed to on a different app, so I guess I’ll keep using it… but if you are on the hunt for a new app when you read this-this one ain’t it, keep scrolling.

I’m one of those people that usually suffers with built in apps, but my partner got me onto Overcast. It’s been several years now and I never want to switch to anything else. I love the speed up function, the sleep timer, and the ability to have different preferences for each podcast.  Thank you for all your hard work with the  rewrite. I tend to hate when apps change, but I had no problems at all. Marco, you rock!

title.label: Not what it used to be

content.label: I have used Overcast for years as it provided a much nicer alternative to Apple’s built-in podcast app, and much more control over the specifics of downloading/retention. But recently, downloads have been regularly failing, playback has been stopping in the middle episodes for no apparent reason, and the app has been clawing away at my phone’s CPU, bringing the entire phone to a crawl. Overcast is starting to feel more and more like actual malware. Goodbye, at least until this stuff is dealt with.
Overcast is a great podcast app with excellent features. Being able to slow speech or speed it up, shorten pauses, and boost voice make this app great for efficient or relaxing playback.

Frequently when play is pressed, the app enters an endless loading circle and never plays the podcast until you hard restart the program. After enough tries, it eventually gets going. Logs and feedback sent, but right now the app is unusable.
I’ve been subscribing for years. Happy to pay for the best podcast out there.

I miss Stitcher, but settled on Overcast after many other tries. Takes a bit of use to get the hang of Overcast, but then you can customize it to your liking. 

No fees, almost zero ads, little hassle at all. A solid free choice for most podcast listeners!

July9/25 such a wonderful app, with responsive attention to bugs that may be inadvertently introduced. I highly recommend this podcast app. 
July 31/24 Love the latest redesign, however, on M4 iPad Pro unable to subscribe to Overcast Premium. Button not working even with quitting app & device restart. Also required to restart app frequently to be able to view information on podcasts. Update, using Overcast has really made such a huge difference to my podcast listening experience. I highly recommend it. Wonderful app. It’s so nice to finally have sync reliable between iOS devices. I wish I knew about it sooner! Thank you.
No developer puts more thought or care into their app. This is the most polished, most useful, most beautiful podcast app. Don’t think twice, download now.

Just imagine, you can press play and have podcasts ready for you queued up by your preferences any time. With shortcuts, I can have the news already playing every morning no matter what I was listening to last - no need to even touch my phone to start. Then if my favorites are ready they follow automatically. Magic!

title.label: Next episode almost never plays properly

content.label: This app continues to be buggy even after so many updates. To this day, the next episode still won’t play inconsistently while I’m streaming. The app either buffers indefinitely, or skips over an entire episode or two and mark as played. Why?? This happens on full bars of data OR very strong wifi. Honestly the app was better before the rewrite

I used to say this app was basically perfect. The changes in the most recent version of the UI are awful. Used to be so easy to click play. Now I have to scroll, click, scroll, click THEN scroll AGAIN so I can see the play button thatis now always hidden behind the awful new UI. Terrible changes. Used to be almost perfect now it sucks nice job Marco.

title.label: Let me disable the equalizer effect

content.label: Love this app and even paid for the premium tier however I find the equalizer effect /animation on the pause button very distracting and would like an option to disable it. Completely a minor nitpick but would appreciate the option to just have a solid coloured button like all the others.

title.label: Best podcast app. Smart speed is so nice

content.label: I like dedicated apps. The smart sped feature and organization is very good

Probably my first ever review of an app in the app store. I heard Marco telling how bad he felt receiving bad reviews for the swift app rewrite.

Marco, continue your good work. I love your app and the last big update is a nice refresh.

Sylvain
While the initial update had some bugs, since then the app has been super solid. I love how it works, the functionality it has. The syncing across devices feels the most reliable it has ever been

title.label: The most capable and well-built podcast app

content.label: I’ve been using Overcast pretty much daily for over eight years. I chose it simply because it was better designed and more feature-rich than other podcast apps — and that remains true today. I couldn’t recommend it more.

title.label: broke the most important part, downloading

content.label:
Been a long time paying user and it was always worth every penny…until the rewrite. 

The big flaw is it can’t download podcasts consistently. It shows a progress bar that indicates it has completed a download and then only plays the first couple bytes. Sometimes it just gets into download loop which never completes. Oh and it can no longer stream podcasts either.

I miss the old app, it was solid.

title.label: Still buggy, nearly one year after the rewrite

content.label: This was easily the best podcast app for nearly a decade, but after the rewrite last year it hasn’t been the same. Even after necessary features that were removed (like streaming podcasts instead of predownloading) were added back, there are still numerous bugs that make it frustrating to use. Of the alternatives I’ve tried, PocketCast has been the best
I love this app! It is better than any other for iOS. I really appreciate that it’s free and my guess is it’s designed and created by people who actually listen to podcasts.
I thought the bugs when changing to the new platform would be temporary. They aren’t. Trying to delete podcasts is like playing whack a mole. They just keep reappearing. I miss the old Overcast.

This app is nothing short of fantastic. Been using it for years and can‘t imagine ever moving to a different one. 
If you‘re doubting whether to pay for a podcasting app when Spotify, Apple and other offer free functionality - give this app a try and you won‘t be disappointed. 

Sidenote: I miss the previous timer functionality since the recent upgrade. Maybe it can be brought back as an option.
Simple. Free. Customizable.
I heart radio gives you a survey when you install. Nuts ta’ that

I've been using overcast since day one. Pretty sad to write this, but I don’t really see any other recourse. The recent major update has made resuming an episode in progress about 75% reliable. This is a fundamental function of the app. I messaged the developer to report the bug, but haven’t heard any sort of acknowledgement that he even sees it as an issue that needs to be addressed. Seems it may have something to do with episodes that start as streamed, or maybe are initiated using CarPlay. Either way, it’s annoying and disruptive. Never had any kind of fundamental issue like this before in the entire history of the app. Discussion of increasing the subscription pricing while the app is in this state has me looking at the Apple Podcasts app? Like, come on.

title.label: Rewrite seems good on the surface but many bad things below

content.label: I don’t mind the rewrite UI and I’m sure I’ll get used to it. What merits the 1 star review is that the app loses its playback position. Often. That’s table stakes and should never happen. I’m glad Marco brought back the shortcuts feature and moved the sleep timer back with proper functionality. The reorder bug I think is mostly fixed as well. I have hope for the future of the app but hopefully this huge bug gets fixed soon.

title.label: Used to be THE podcast app

content.label: Constant bugs, episodes not getting downloaded properly, episodes crashing mid way through the episode and other UI bugs have forced me to look elsewhere. Sad that this hasn’t had any updates in a long time and now is nearly unusable.

I still have my iPhone SE with the old app and it never has issues.  When I use it on my new phone, with the updated app, it often crashes or simply stop playing as it loads.  There is likely a high dependency on the network connection, I have 30mbps, it is high enough for HD streaming but seem to be limit for podcasts on the latest update.  I don’t want to be too harsh but it is very frustrating for an app that was flawless before the update.  Either way, I know you will fix it and I wish you find the bug.  I will change my rating back to 5 star once addressed.

Seem to bug really hard when closing the screen or switching app while playing an episode that has not finished downloading

There were bugs introduced in the major rewrite last year that still have not been addressed.

Overcast remembering changes to playlists, such as adding episodes or reordering them, is so unreliable that I am surprised when it actually works. Sometimes it randomly stops playing the current episode and skips to the next one for no reason, or stops at the end of an episode and refuses to start the next one.

These are essential features of a podcast app that have been broken for many, many months, and there doesn’t appear to be any active development to fix them.
There is nothing that comes close to the functionality and design of OC. It’s clean, simple and intuitive. Have used for years and will do so for years hopefully.
One of my favourite apps but hard to recommend right now as streaming downloads constantly fail and other bugs causing episodes to switch mid listen.
Easily configurable, very flexible... it just works and it works great.  Thanks!

title.label: I never wanted to rate this down

content.label: But Marco doesn’t overly respond to feedback in any other manner, and the app has been completely broken. Hitting the pause button skips the podcast. I’ve deleted and redownloaded and everything. Scrolling a list jumps to the last location you touched which is wrong behaviour.

title.label: Smart Speed is all that's left

content.label:
The last round of unneeded "improvements" has seemingly sacrificed basic functionality like "reliability". We don't need Spotify Wrapped for our podcasts, we need them to download reliably. We need the app to know that we have hundreds of GBs left when it reports "no space left". We need a download button rather than the app deciding it might download something at some point. Marco, please focus on reliability- it's what will keep users. 

Smart Speed is the only reason I haven't switched to Pocket Casts.
Loving the redesign. The row of new eps at the top is awesome and and it feels faster and more stable.

Too busy running his new restaurant, he left the app abandoned with critical bugs that plague my everyday use. 

When you resume an unfinished podcast, 50% of the time it just skips to the next podcast in the playlist. Unusable.
Can’t get a better podcasting app
Thanks for not being a horrible corporate mess. I’m glad I switched off of major podcast apps nearly a decade ago. It’s awesome
I have a self-hosted server and would love to have them sync with my iPhone.  Right now, it’s the only one that doesn’t out of all of my devices

This is my go-to podcast app. However, since the redesign it seems to be rather buggy, often failing to download episodes or stopping them mid-playback. Rather annoying. Please bring back the stability, that’s more important than a snazzy interface!
Used to be my favourite podcast player but now not only the UI is a complete mess, the damn things can’t play an episode without constantly switching to another one. Just horrible
Intuitive interface  and easy to use. Just works.
Excellent podcast app and much better than the others I have used
It’ amazing app good podcasts nice user base
Easy to use, to organize my podcasts, easy to control settings, easy to find podcasts, easy to search all episodes easy to do everything I need on a podcast app.

title.label: Does everything I want in a podcast player BUT ...

content.label: I have no complaints about Overcast. I find it easy to use and to find interesting new podcasts to listen to. But, I noticed a huge discrepancy between the storage space used as reported by the app itself vs my iPhone’s storage report. I had to entirely remove the app to recover almost 20 GB of space despite having only a few downloaded episodes. I also noticed that deleted podcasts would reappear and I would have to delete them again. It seems the app is not truly deleting when it says it is, whether it's individual episodes or entire podcasts, which is why I had to completely remove the app. Too bad, really, since I did like it.
Came back to this after a year of not listening to podcasts and now nothing works. Can’t even load an episode without rebooting the app. This app used to be great, I’m so disappointed with it now.

Whenever I open this app to start listening to a podcast, the list of episodes is sorted by “current” instead of by “all”, via a slider at the top of the list. I’ve found no way to permanently make my podcasts appear with all episodes visible so this switch needs to be hit every time in order to “unhide” a number of episodes. Use another app that shows all episodes by default.
Love Overcast with the best podcast available but I’m a bit frustrated by not having the option to download episodes on cellular network instead of just wifi

I don’t know what happened. It used to be, that when I had a column of podcasts in a list, the top one would play, and when that one was finished, the next one would play and so on. Now, the episode plays, and the next one does not start automatically. I have to manually start the next one which is a major pain. any remedies?
